name: umpire
description: Runs your tests after Claude edits code and makes the call. Off by default.

enabled.title: On from the start
enabled.description: Run the tests after every turn that changes files, in every session, without typing /umpire on.

command.title: Test command
command.description: The command to run, as you would type it (run through sh). Empty: found from the project (package.json's test script, pytest, go test, cargo test).

maxSeconds.title: Time limit (seconds)
maxSeconds.description: A run longer than this is stopped and called timed out. 5 to 600.
